name: mock-craft
description: Zero-dependency CLI (v3): deterministic seed (Mulberry32), nullChance, _collections + ref, TS types export, HTTP mock server — plus v2 nested schema features.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node bin/index.js generate -s schema.example.json -c 1 -f json > /dev/null && node bin/index.js generate -s schema.advanced.example.json -c 1 -f csv > /dev/null && node bin/index.js generate -s schema.collections.example.json --seed prepublish-ci -f json > /dev/null && node bin/index.js generate -s schema.collections.example.json --seed prepublish-ci -f sql > /dev/null
